newsitem.title: USA: Scott & Stringfellow sets split, payout.
newsitem.headline: Scott & Stringfellow sets split, payout.

text.p: Scott & Stringfellow Financial Inc said directors approved a three-for-two stock split in the form of a 50 percent stock dividend and an unchanged cash payout of $0.12 per share.
The stock dividend will be distributed May 6 to holders of record on April 18, the company said. The quarterly cash dividend will be paid April 15 to holders of record March 27.
It said the stock dividend will increase the number of outstanding shares to about 3.12 million from about 2.08 million. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
